title.narrative: Review of unep´s marine and coastal program
Översyn av unep´s marin och kustprogram

description.narrative:
PLEASE REVIEW YOUR ANSWER AS THE QUESTION HAS BEEN CHANGED
The purpose of the consultancy is to assess the performance of UNEP in achieving the project objectives for the program “Implementation of the UNEP Marine and Coastal Strategy for Africa”. Specifically, the review should assess the program’s relevance, efficiency, effectiveness and sustainability, lessons-learnt and ultimately propose practical recommendations for actions to be followed-up if a decision is reached for continued support of 5MSEK.
Syftet med konsultuppdraget är att utvärdera UNEPs resultat mot uppsatta projektmål. Mer specifikt ska utvärderingen bedöma projektets relevans, kostnadseffektivitet, övergripande effektivitets- och hållbarhetsaspekter, samt lärdomar från projektets gång. Konsulten ska därutöver föreslå praktiska rekommendationer för uppföljning inför eventuellt förlängt stöd om 5MSEK.

The consultancy will assess performance of UNEP in achieving project objectives for the program "Implementation of the UNEP Marine and Coastal Strategy for Africa". Specifically, the review should assess the relevance, efficiency, effectiveness and sustainability, lessons-learnt and ultimately propose recommendations to be followed-up if a proposed 5M SEK addition support is disbursed.
